audience.text: C++ developers building desktop or server applications that need to process Outlook MSG, CFB, and EML email formats without external dependencies or runtime licensing costs.

capabilities.text: Create, edit, and reload Outlook-style messages through mapi_message, setting subject, plain-text and HTML bodies, and sender identity.
capabilities.title: High-level message authoring

capabilities.text: Read, build, and write generic Compound File Binary containers directly through cfb_reader, cfb_storage/cfb_stream, and cfb_writer.
capabilities.title: Low-level CFB access

capabilities.text: Save an in-memory mapi_message to .eml and load .eml back into a mapi_message, both through the library's own MIME engine.
capabilities.title: MSG/EML interoperability

capabilities.text: Add To/Cc/Bcc recipients with add_recipient, attach regular files from byte buffers or streams with add_attachment, and nest a full mapi_message as an embedded-message attachment.
capabilities.title: Recipients and attachments

limitations.text: No SMTP, IMAP, POP3, or other network mail-protocol support — this library reads and writes MSG, CFB, and EML containers and messages already on disk, in memory, or in a stream; it is not a mail client or transport library.
No PST (Outlook Personal Folders) archive support — only single MSG-format messages and generic CFB containers are supported, not multi-message PST stores.
Only a curated subset of MAPI properties has a dedicated named accessor on mapi_message; every other property must be read and written through the generic get_property_value()/set_property() pair.

problems_solved.text: Enables deterministic, dependency-free parsing and generation of Outlook MSG and EML email formats in C++17 applications.
Provides both high-level message authoring and low-level structural access to MSG and CFB containers for flexible integration.
Supports saving messages to both MSG and EML formats using the library's own MIME engine without external dependencies.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Email FOSS for C++ is a C++17 library for reading and writing binary email containers and messages — Compound File Binary (CFB) containers, Outlook MSG documents, and RFC 5322 / MIME EML files — with deterministic, byte-level output and no third-party library dependency of its own.

uncertainties: The exact set of MAPI properties supported by the high-level mapi_message API is not fully enumerated in the facts.
The behavior of strict-validation mode in msg_reader and msg_document is not detailed beyond the existence of validation_issues().
Whether the library supports reading or writing HTML bodies in MSG format is implied but not explicitly confirmed by examples.
The exact version of CMake required beyond the minimum of 3.26 is not specified.
The behavior of save() and save_to_eml() when called with no arguments (returning std::vector<std::uint8_t>) is not demonstrated in examples.

workflows.name: Read MSG subject
workflows.text: Open a .msg file as a binary stream and use mapi_message::from_stream to extract the subject.

workflows.name: Create and save message
workflows.text: Create a message with mapi_message::create, set sender, recipients, and attachments, then save to both .msg and .eml formats.
